text:
Border control can be unpredictable sometimes, but most of the issues you see here are about parents visiting when their child is in Israel as part of the partner-visa process - they are flagged because their names are taken down as part of the application. 

We have an article on our website which is worth reading carefully :) Also you can ignore the security check at the airport last time - that is a completely different process that isn't shared with immigration. https://aic.org.il/entry-to-israel-of-a-foreign-partner-of-an-israeli/
